image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a Blenheim spaniel (Cavalier King Charles Spaniel) resting on a textured concrete or stone surface. The dog's head is the primary focus, showing characteristic red and white markings, long feathered ears, and closed eyes. A portion of the front paw is visible in the lower left. In the upper right background, a dark object resembling a shoe or boot is partially visible.
